Evidence caveats

  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.

Evidence caveats

  • 1,212 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.
  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.
  • Matchup playbooks describe what the field policy repeatedly selected against each opponent. They do not claim the most-used bring or lead causally outperforms alternatives.
  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.
  • Legacy exact context: 1,212 games at 70.5%; excluded from the headline and evidence grade.

Evidence caveats

  • 30 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.
  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.
  • Legacy exact context: 30 games at 36.7%; excluded from the headline and evidence grade.

Evidence caveats

  • 30 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.
  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.
  • Legacy exact context: 30 games at 60.0%; excluded from the headline and evidence grade.

Evidence caveats

  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.

Evidence caveats

  • 30 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.

Evidence caveats

  • 1,488,369 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.
  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.
  • Legacy exact context: 1,488,369 games at 41.7%; excluded from the headline and evidence grade.

Evidence caveats

  • 20,496 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.
  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.
  • Matchup playbooks describe what the field policy repeatedly selected against each opponent. They do not claim the most-used bring or lead causally outperforms alternatives.
  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.
  • Legacy exact context: 20,496 games at 67.9%; excluded from the headline and evidence grade.
